source.name: Vedomosti (press-release section): Альфа-Банк стал партнером хоккейного клуба «Авангард»
source.quote: Церемония подписания состоялась 4 декабря на 12-тысячной G-Drive Арене.
source.note: English: 'The signing ceremony took place on 4 December at the 12,000-seat G-Drive Arena.' G-Drive is a Gazprom Neft fuel brand (the club's partners page: G-Drive fuel sold at Gazpromneft filling stations; Gazprom Neft 'started the construction of the new home arena for the club'). Naming-rights start and value not published.

note: Avangard's home arena is branded G-Drive Arena, a Gazprom Neft brand; naming terms not published.
